# Huawei Enterprise

> Huawei Enterprise delivers industrial intelligence and digital transformation solutions through cloud, AI, storage, and network technologies across global markets.

Huawei Enterprise (e.huawei.com) is a global B2B platform showcasing ICT solutions for industrial intelligence and digital transformation. The site operates regional portals across Asia-Pacific, Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Latin America, each featuring localized cloud products, storage systems, smart logistics, and AI-powered enterprise solutions.

## Key Topics

- Huawei Enterprise
- Huawei Cloud
- Industrial Intelligence
- Cloud Services
- AI Acceleration
- Smart Logistics Hub
- OceanStor Storage
- Wi-Fi 7
- Digital Transformation
- Data Protection
- Network Infrastructure
- Enterprise Solutions
- Manufacturing
- Wireless Networking
- GIGA+

## Global Regional Portals

- [Huawei Enterprise: Accelerate Industrial Intelligence](https://e.huawei.com/en): Global Huawei Enterprise homepage showcasing ICT solutions and industrial intelligence
- [Huawei Enterprise China](https://e.huawei.com/cn): China regional site with cloud, AI, and comprehensive industry solutions
- [Huawei Enterprise Asia-Pacific](https://e.huawei.com/sg): Singapore hub featuring OceanStor storage and wireless technology solutions
- [Huawei Enterprise Southeast Asia](https://e.huawei.com/my): Malaysia regional site with digital transformation solutions
- [Huawei Enterprise Japan](https://e.huawei.com/jp): Japan site with cloud products and Wi-Fi 7 technology
- [Huawei Enterprise Indonesia](https://e.huawei.com/id): Indonesia site with cloud and storage systems solutions
- [Huawei Enterprise Philippines](https://e.huawei.com/ph): Philippines site featuring cloud and data protection solutions
- [Huawei Enterprise Thailand](https://e.huawei.com/th): Thailand regional site with cloud and business solutions
- [Huawei Enterprise Australia](https://e.huawei.com/au): Australia site with cloud infrastructure and logistics solutions
- [Huawei Enterprise Hong Kong](https://e.huawei.com/hk): Hong Kong site featuring OceanStor storage and IdeaHub products

## Regional Markets - Middle East & Africa

- [Huawei Enterprise Saudi Arabia](https://e.huawei.com/sa): Saudi Arabia site with Smart Logistics Hub and AI solutions
- [Huawei Enterprise UAE](https://e.huawei.com/ae): UAE regional site featuring cloud and network infrastructure
- [Huawei Enterprise South Africa](https://e.huawei.com/za): South Africa site featuring Smart Logistics Hub
- [Huawei Enterprise Morocco](https://e.huawei.com/ma): Morocco regional site with cloud and manufacturing solutions

## Regional Markets - Americas & Europe

- [Huawei Enterprise Brazil](https://e.huawei.com/br): Brazil site with cloud products and storage technology
